name: C&C: Shockwave
description: A large fan-made overhaul of Zero Hour with new units, generals and balance (ModDB Editor's Choice 2008).
notes: On the download page choose the full release. Shockwave ships as a Windows installer (.exe, usually inside a .zip). Run it on Windows (or Wine or CrossOver), install to a new empty folder, then choose that folder here. A plain .zip of the game files installs directly.

name: C&C: Shockwave Chaos
description: A deliberately over-the-top add-on for Shockwave with lots of new and reworked units, generals and abilities.
notes: An add-on for Shockwave: you need both to play. Its download is a plain .zip that installs directly. Rallypoint combines it with Shockwave when you launch, so nothing in your Shockwave folder is changed.
